Photo.title: Photo
Photo.description: Metadata for a user's photo or video stored in Cloudflare R2.

file_name.description: Original filename of the photo or video.

file_type.description: MIME type of the media file (image/* or video/*).

file_url.description: Public Cloudflare R2 URL for the uploaded media object.

file_size.description: Size of the uploaded media object in bytes.

is_favorite.description: Whether the user starred this media item.

album.description: Album name or trash marker (__trash__ or __trash__::<album>).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the media record was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the media record was last modified.

Album.title: Album
Album.description: User-created album metadata synced across devices.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the album was created.

/users/{userId}/photos/{photoId}.description: Private photo and video metadata documents owned by a single authenticated user.

/users/{userId}/albums/{albumId}.description: Private album definitions owned by a single authenticated user.
